title: Benchmarks: nyxd vs Docker vs Podman (Alpine 3.23 / QEMU)
description: Compare the same workload on three as similar as possible Alpine Linux 3.23 guests under QEMU. One VM runs Docker, one Podman, one nyxd + nyx. Goal: apples-to-apples numbers for startup, resource use, and steady-state behavior—not a claim of “fastest in all cases.”
